pages.text: Hold a gift over a lit brazier and right-click: the god it pleases burns it and blesses you for 5 minutes. The gods hear one gift every 3 minutes.
Zeus takes a gold ingot: strength and resistance. Athena, olives: luck and experience. Hermes, a feather: speed and jumping. Poseidon, a fish: water breathing and dolphin's grace.
Demeter takes wheat or bread: a full belly and healing. Hephaestus, Hephaestus coal: fire resistance and haste.
